Whats the difference between discretionary and mandatory spending? Which one is close to reality?

Both are reality. They are just pieces of the total that the federal government spends.

Mandatory Spending is federal spending that is spent based on existing laws rather than the budgeting process. It accounts for 2/3 of spending.

Discretionary Spending is the portion of the budget that the president requests and Congress appropriates every year. It accounts for less than 1/3 of spending.
